shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'PORT=3100 npm run dev -- --port 3100 > /tmp/next-dev.log 2>&1 & DEV_PID=$!; for i in $(seq 1 30); do if curl -s -o /tmp/admin.html -w "%{http_code}" http://127.0.0.1:3100/admin >/tmp/admin.status 2>/dev/null; then break; fi; sleep 1; done; STATUS=$(cat /tmp/admin.status); echo "STATUS=$STATUS"; kill $DEV_PID; wait $DEV_PID 2>/dev/null || true; head -n 5 /tmp/admin.html'
